# World Economic Forum

> The World Economic Forum publishes research, analysis, initiatives and event coverage on major global economic, social, environmental and technological issues.

The World Economic Forum (WEF) is an international organization for public-private cooperation. Its website includes topical explainers and stories, strategic reports and white papers, initiative pages, podcasts and videos, and coverage of annual meetings and other convenings.

## Main Site and Navigation
- [World Economic Forum](https://www.weforum.org/): Main portal for WEF research, stories, initiatives, events and organizational information.
- [Agenda](https://www.weforum.org/agenda/): Editorial hub for articles, explainers and analysis across global issues.
- [Reports](https://www.weforum.org/publications/): Library of WEF reports, white papers and strategic insight publications.
- [Videos](https://www.weforum.org/videos/): Video interviews, explainers and event sessions from WEF platforms.
- [Podcasts](https://www.weforum.org/podcasts/): Audio series covering economics, technology, climate and global affairs.
- [Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution](https://www.weforum.org/centre-for-the-fourth-industrial-revolution/): WEF platform focused on governance and applications of emerging technologies.
- [About the Forum](https://www.weforum.org/about-the-forum/): Organizational overview, mission, leadership and governance information.

## Agenda and Editorial Content
- [Agenda](https://www.weforum.org/agenda/): Central editorial destination for current analysis and commentary on global challenges.
- [Stories](https://www.weforum.org/stories/): Browse WEF story collections by topic, issue and publication date.
- [Press releases](https://www.weforum.org/press/): Official announcements, statements and media updates from the Forum.
- [Podcasts](https://www.weforum.org/podcasts/): Editorial audio content featuring experts, leaders and WEF contributors.
- [Videos](https://www.weforum.org/videos/): Recorded interviews, short features and event highlights.
- [Strategic Intelligence](https://intelligence.weforum.org/): Data-driven platform mapping issues, trends and interconnections across global systems.

## Reports and Publications
- [Publications](https://www.weforum.org/publications/): Searchable index of reports, briefs and white papers from WEF teams.
- [Global Risks Report](https://www.weforum.org/publications/global-risks-report-2024/): Annual assessment of major global risks and their interconnections.
- [Future of Jobs Report](https://www.weforum.org/publications/the-future-of-jobs-report-2023/): Analysis of labor market shifts, skills demand and workforce transformation.
- [Global Gender Gap Report](https://www.weforum.org/publications/global-gender-gap-report-2024/): Benchmarking report on gender parity across economies and sectors.
- [Energy Transition Index](https://www.weforum.org/publications/fostering-effective-energy-transition-2024/): Research on energy system performance, resilience and transition readiness.
- [Chief Economists Outlook](https://www.weforum.org/publications/chief-economists-outlook-may-2024/): Periodic survey of leading economists on global economic conditions.
- [Global Cybersecurity Outlook](https://www.weforum.org/publications/global-cybersecurity-outlook-2024/): Report on cyber risk trends, resilience and security priorities.

## Topical Hubs
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.weforum.org/topics/artificial-intelligence/): Topic page for AI governance, adoption, safety and economic impact.
- [Climate Change](https://www.weforum.org/topics/climate-change/): Coverage of climate risks, mitigation, adaptation and policy responses.
- [Energy Transition](https://www.weforum.org/topics/energy-transition/): Research and stories on decarbonization, power systems and clean energy.
- [Future of Work](https://www.weforum.org/topics/future-of-work/): Content on jobs, skills, automation and workforce transformation.
- [Global Health](https://www.weforum.org/topics/global-health/): Analysis of health systems, preparedness, equity and innovation.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.weforum.org/topics/cybersecurity/): Topic hub for digital security, resilience and cyber governance.
- [Trade and Investment](https://www.weforum.org/topics/trade-and-investment/): Coverage of trade flows, industrial policy and global investment trends.
- [Geopolitics](https://www.weforum.org/topics/geopolitics/): Analysis of international relations, conflict and strategic competition.

## Strategic Intelligence and Data Tools
- [Strategic Intelligence](https://intelligence.weforum.org/): Interactive platform connecting issues, trends, reports and expert perspectives.
- [Transformation Maps](https://intelligence.weforum.org/topics): Explore issue maps showing relationships among global topics and drivers.
- [Reports on Strategic Intelligence](https://www.weforum.org/publications/?query=strategic%20intelligence): Publications related to systems thinking and issue mapping.
- [TopLink](https://toplink.weforum.org/): Collaboration platform used by Forum communities and stakeholders.
- [UpLink](https://uplink.weforum.org/uplink/s/): Innovation ecosystem connecting entrepreneurs with sustainability challenges and support.

## Centres, Platforms and Initiatives
- [Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution](https://www.weforum.org/centre-for-the-fourth-industrial-revolution/): Platform for policy frameworks and pilot projects on emerging technologies.
- [UpLink](https://uplink.weforum.org/uplink/s/): Open innovation platform for early-stage impact ventures and challenge programs.
- [Global Shapers Community](https://www.globalshapers.org/): Youth network of local hubs driving community-led impact initiatives.
- [Schwab Foundation for Social Entrepreneurship](https://www.schwabfound.org/): Community and platform supporting leading social innovators worldwide.
- [Forum of Young Global Leaders](https://www.younggloballeaders.org/): Leadership community for emerging leaders across sectors and regions.
- [Giving to Amplify Impact](https://www.weforum.org/giving-to-amplify-impact/): Information on philanthropic support for Forum initiatives and impact.

## Events and Meetings
- [Meetings](https://www.weforum.org/events/): Directory of WEF annual meetings, summits and regional events.
- [Annual Meeting](https://www.weforum.org/events/world-economic-forum-annual-meeting): Main Davos meeting page with programme and related content.
- [Annual Meeting of the New Champions](https://www.weforum.org/events/annual-meeting-of-the-new-champions-2024): Event page for the Forum’s innovation and growth-focused meeting.
- [Sustainable Development Impact Meetings](https://www.weforum.org/events/sustainable-development-impact-meetings-2024): Convening focused on SDGs, climate and development priorities.
- [Special Meeting on Global Collaboration, Growth and Energy for Development](https://www.weforum.org/events/special-meeting-on-global-collaboration-growth-and-energy-for-development-2024): Event page for regional and global cooperation discussions.
- [Event sessions on videos](https://www.weforum.org/videos/): Recorded sessions and highlights from Forum meetings and summits.

## Media Formats
- [Podcasts](https://www.weforum.org/podcasts/): WEF podcast series on economics, technology, sustainability and society.
- [Radio Davos](https://www.weforum.org/podcasts/radio-davos): Podcast featuring interviews and discussions from WEF experts and guests.
- [Meet the Leader](https://www.weforum.org/podcasts/meet-the-leader): Leadership interview podcast with CEOs, policymakers and changemakers.
- [Videos](https://www.weforum.org/videos/): Video library of explainers, interviews and event recordings.
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/user/worldeconomicforum): Official video channel for sessions, interviews and short features.
- [Press releases](https://www.weforum.org/press/): Official media announcements and institutional communications.

## About, Leadership and Careers
- [About the Forum](https://www.weforum.org/about-the-forum/): Overview of WEF mission, history and institutional model.
- [Our mission](https://www.weforum.org/about/world-economic-forum/): Background on the Forum’s purpose and role in public-private cooperation.
- [Leadership and governance](https://www.weforum.org/about/leadership-and-governance/): Information on the Board of Trustees and executive leadership.
- [Partners](https://www.weforum.org/partners/): Overview of the Forum’s partner ecosystem and engagement model.
- [Careers](https://www.weforum.org/careers/): Employment opportunities and information about working at WEF.
- [Contact us](https://www.weforum.org/contact-us/): Contact information for general inquiries and media requests.
